% Notation fragment for the quantum-observable-universe paper.
%
% Appended after the folio-assistant-sci paper print template
% (folio-assistant-sci/adapters/paper/latex/paper-preamble.tex) by the
% paper-feature-build Tool, which reads this path by default. These lines are
% VERBATIM from main.tex lines 1-827 at ddd4841b8ce (owner decisions D1/D2,
% 2026-10-04, bean qou-feso): the paper's own notation, kept with the paper.
% Do not edit a line here to fix a rendering; fix the .md.

\newunicodechar{𝓑}{\unimathsafe{\mathcal{B}}}      % U+1D4D1 script B (braid word)
\newcommand{\bigbowtie}{\mathop{\triangleright\!\!\!\triangleleft}}
% Contact form (pseudo-Hermitian structure) symbol.  NOTE: paper-specific —
% per this file's header, such macros belong in a paper's generated preamble,
% not in the shared template; left here pending migration to the content repo.
% \varTheta is the upright capital theta, visually distinct from the
% lowercase contact-form letter θ and from italic \Theta.
% Some recent TeX Live distributions predefine \varTheta; redefine safely.
\providecommand{\varTheta}{}
\renewcommand{\varTheta}{\mathrm{\Theta}}
% ── Reeb / compound-macro stubs: REMOVED 2026-08-22 ───────────────────────────
% This block defined 16 macros whose names are author typos — a control
% sequence written without the space that separates it from the next token
% (\pi c_s -> \pic_s, \xi Z -> \xiZ, \lambda L -> \lambdaL). Defining the
% glued name makes the page compile, and that is the problem: it converts a
% loud failure into silently-wrong printed mathematics. Two did exactly that.
% \pic expanded to \pi, so `2\pic_s` printed 2\pi_s and the sound speed
% vanished from a Hawking-temperature denominator that the same block's prose
% writes correctly as 2\pi c_s. \xid expanded to \xi_d, so
% `\mathcal{L}_\xid\alpha` printed the Lie derivative along a subscripted
% field with no argument instead of \mathcal{L}_\xi d\alpha. \xid, \xiZ and
% \xiA were commented here as "Reeb vector field variants"; no such notation
% is registered in folio/quantum-observable-universe/notation/, so the
% comment documents three typos as though they were notation.
% Every source site is fixed; do not restore these. If one reappears, the
% undefined-control-sequence error is the correct outcome — fix the .md.
\newcommand{\pp}{p}             % prime p — used in p-adic content (\mathbb{Q}_\pp, \mathbb{F}_\pp, v_\pp). Italic per math-mode convention; not \mathfrak{p} which is reserved for the proton (CLAUDE.md §7aa).
% \unicode{codepoint} — ConTeXt-style; used in appendix-surreals for ☉ (U+2609)
\newcommand{\unicode}[1]{\ensuremath{\odot}}
% Young-diagram macro stub (ytableau not loaded; renders partition as list)
\newcommand{\yng}[1]{{\scriptsize[#1]}}
\newunicodechar{𝔙}{\mathfrak{V}}
